{{Quote|Peace is for nerfs.|Tyla Praji|<ref name="tinker" />}}
'''Tyla Praji''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the powerful [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]], whose [[Parent/Legends|father]] was [[Nahdonnis Praji]], who served as a military [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They participated in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] and held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commissar/Legends|Commissar]]. Praji disliked [[Time/Legends|time]] without war and despised people who preferred peace.<ref name="tinker" /> In [[104 ABY]],<ref name="blog">The last section of ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'' is titled "''Inheritance (10&ndash;104 ABY)''". {{Blog|valinkenobi|14/comments|TTSP Endnotes: Volume 1}} states that the [[in-universe]] article was published in 104 ABY.</ref> Tyla Praji was mentioned briefly in [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Academician|Dr.]] [[Gabrel Treon]]'s history article titled "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]." Other details of their life were published in [[Doovo Bonkik]]'s ''[[Fortune's Sons]]'' and in [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al's]] interview transcriptions accessible at [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] node 786-12F-060540.<ref name="tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyla Praji was mentioned in a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace-exclusive]] [[in-universe]] history article titled ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', written by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[February 5]], [[2009]].<ref name="tinker" />
